ops.title: Update CCI Go toolchain past GO-2026-6859
ops.description: Held behind active CCI read-model repair. CI544 vulnerability scanner reports net/http in go1.26.10 affected by GO-2026-6859 and fixed in go1.26.11. Evidence: ~/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/cci-544-vuln.log. Next: update pinned build toolchain and rerun hosted vuln scan; no local compiler jobs.

ops.text: Hosted vulnerability check passes with fixed Go toolchain
